text:
incident-bot: ALERT: latency SLO breach detected (p99 > 1.5s) in us-west inference-serving. PagerDuty incident PD-INC-9221 fired and auto-paged primary oncall.
alex: Acked PD-INC-9221. I'm on it.
sana: seeing spike in kv-cache evictions + composer model tail. ~10k reqs/min. Possible hot keys?
jules: I'm taking lead for the rotation. Rerouting traffic to us-west-fallback-1 now. mike, can you warm caches and run quick health checks?
mike: running warmup -> `./scripts/warm_kv.sh --region us-west --target 100k`
alex: lowering batch to 16 for composer model via rollout-rt config: `batch_size:16`
alex: current metrics snapshot:
```
p95: 420ms
p99: 1.82s
inflight_q: 1.2k
kv_evictions/s: 450
model_throughput: 11.3k req/min
```
incident-bot: PD-INC-9221 escalated to secondary after 90s (escalation-record).
jules: reroute completed. early signals: p99 -> 1.12s, evictions dropping. keeping an eye on 5m windows.
sana: started aux cache priming for suspected hotkey set. throttling non-urgent batch jobs for 10m.
jules: partial customer impact: intermittent 504s reported for a small group of low-throughput tenants (correlated with hotkey traffic). flagging support so they can surface any sensitive customers.
alex: rollback noisy route overrides and enable KV warmup policy for that keyset as short-term fix.
mike: warmup finished, KV hit-rate increased to 96%.
jules: p99 trending ~900ms and falling. keeping PD incident open for 30m monitoring, then will close if stable. :thumbsup:
sana: noted — filing post-incident followup ticket (ops-6893) with root-cause notes.
alex: thanks team, good triage. will follow up in the postmortem. closing loop in 30.
